licences.qualification: The 2021 paper describes an initial noncommercial release; the pinned README declares CC BY 4.0. Underlying document rights are not inferred from the code licence.

public_metadata_evidence.statement: About 500 financial reports released in the past two years were collected from annualreports.com; no comprehensive dev issuer/publication/correction-date inventory is provided in the inspected metadata.
Public path history lists a release in 2021; this points to an earlier development corpus, not a verified per-report source inventory.

TAT-QA.overlap_assessment: Earlier source material is indicated, but a comprehensive issuer and exact report-publication/correction inventory was not established. No affirmative overlap finding is made.

corrected_preprocessing.statement: Pinned README records the 2022-05-04 table_row_to_text correction; no preprocessing was run or older leaky version used.

licences.qualification: Repository licence is not independent clearance of the underlying FinTabNet/report materials.

public_metadata_evidence.statement: S&P 500 earnings reports from 1999 to 2019, collected in FinTabNet. These nominal report years precede the reserved periods but are not a file-level publication/revision inventory.

The pinned development file was updated during the earliest reserved fundamental window. The update alone does not prove protected financial material was introduced; its source-version effect is not established by the inspected metadata.

FinQA.overlap_assessment: Unresolved publication/revision provenance; a fiscal-year range alone cannot waive the stop rule. Issuer sampling is broad S&P 500 rather than a project-specific exclusion list.

hash_note: Listed file identities are Git blob SHA-1 metadata, not downloaded-byte SHA-256 hashes. SHA-256 is null because acquisition stopped.

validation.reason: Documentation and metadata stop receipt only; no code, baseline, scorer or dataset processing implemented.

resources.note: No baseline or scoring job started; metadata review was not instrumented as a compute experiment.

interpretation: No real benchmark result exists. Thirty to forty items could expose defects, not establish skill, formal H1 or historical usability. The pre-download uncertainty is preserved for review rather than resolved by inspecting potentially reserved data.
